title: Pick Your Lane Before the Circle
hook: Two lanes in. The decision is on the approach, not inside.
scene: Bigger roundabout at the highway junction, two lanes going in, arrows painted on the approach and a sign board before them. Your exit is the third one — effectively a left. The lane you're in decides whether you can take it.

source.teaching_target: NEW: PSDP thirteen Lesson three – two or more lane roundabouts. PSDP-only.

image_brief.subject: two approach lanes into a highway-junction roundabout with painted arrows before the circle; full-grid cage; carrier (hard-sided, wire grille door facing inboard, Gracie's orange tabby markings visible behind the grille, belt routed through the handle); NO lit bidirectional dash arrow
image_brief.foreground: worn black wheel, faded pink dash DARK/UNLIT — no lit turn arrows, no bidirectional arrow glow; FULL-GRID welded steel mesh over the entire windshield (VI-009 cage canon) — not a low dash-level band; missing windshield cage is a hard FAIL; carrier (hard-sided, wire grille door facing inboard, Gracie's orange tabby markings visible behind the grille, belt routed through the handle)
image_brief.midground: two approach lanes into the roundabout; painted lane arrows on asphalt only (not lit dash indicators); if a fork sign exists it must have a readable legend or be removed
image_brief.background: Backcountry east of Ribbon — Pacific Northwest only (fir, moss, wet gray); one continuous stretch; no arid canyon, no high desert, no NYC/Spokane drift
image_brief.read: two approach lanes into the junction roundabout; pick your lane before the circle
extra_negatives: no decision already inside the circle
no traffic signal controlling the circle
no second person in the car
no cat loose on the seat
no digital speed readout reading as live speed
no missing carrier when cabin or cage is in frame
Ali alone — only VI-013 has a second person
no carrier door facing outboard/camera unless brief says otherwise
no empty carrier with no cat visible behind grille
no belt not routed through handle
no carrier door facing outboard toward camera
no low dash-level mesh band only
no desert GPS / arid nav HUD
no brightly lit dash by default
no lit bidirectional arrow on the dash
no unlabeled fork post without legend

variation.forced: Act VI Claude overflow locks: PNW Backcountry east of Ribbon; full-grid cage; carrier SPEC verbatim; no Mya; dark dash; no seed

decision: Two lanes, your exit is the far side. Where do you get in line?

options.text: Read the signs and arrows now, take the left lane, stay in it around
options.result: You read the board, take the left, hold your lane the whole way, signal, and leave. Decided before you entered.

options.text: Take the right lane and move left once you're inside
options.result: Changing lanes in a roundabout is how the side of your car meets somebody who was already there.

options.text: Take whichever lane is shorter and sort it out inside
options.result: You pick by queue length and end up on the wrong side of the circle at your exit.

options.text: Stay right and go around twice
options.result: You commit to a lap because you didn't read a sign. The circle takes another turn from you.

debrief: On a multi-lane roundabout, read the signs and arrows before you enter and stay in your lane all the way around.
